source_index_lines: - [[mfr-vandersteen-vlr]] — Vandersteen VLR Wood product page (Tier C)
brand_notes: Vandersteen (Hanford CA): first-order, time-coherent philosophy; compact lineup includes VLR Wood ($2,060/pr), VLR CT; floorstanders out of scope. ASR called VLR second most broken speaker measured (asr-vandersteen-vlr); Treo CT is a 43 in floorstander (out of scope).
takeaways: Maker rates 8 Ω nominal, 5 Ω min; ASR measured 2.3 Ω at ~4 kHz -> effectively-4ohm
Measured sensitivity 81.3 dB vs 86 dB claimed
LW ±3.4 dB, f3 111 Hz sealed, major DI discontinuity, pref 2.6
Tone Audio 2015 glowing (manufacturer-hosted reprint); only 1 owner report
ASR 'VLR' assumed to be the current VLR Wood
conflicts: Tone Audio praise vs ASR measurements
